author: Zoqs
body:
I got banned for 'ban evading'?!?!?! I didn't even knew what this mean't! 
Why I should be unbanned: Because i didn't even knew what it mean't, and I was just having my fun on the server legit, waiting for my other account to be unbanned... But I am really sorry that i was trying to 'ban evade' i just didn't know what it was otherwise i wouldn't have done it. But now i know it and i promise i won't do it ever again!

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Ban evading is the term when a banned user like Flexuz_Strafe uses an alternate account to access the server.

Ban evading is a hard punishment to get appealed. Most cases it never gets appealed.

For now this appeal is denied. You can try your luck in future appeals.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
